Rate-limit error event inside a stream that already returned 200 and two chunks

```rust title="Rust"
use liter_llm::BatchClient;
use liter_llm::FileClient;
use liter_llm::LlmClient;
use liter_llm::ResponseClient;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let req_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"messages":[{"content":"Hello","role":"user"}],"model":"gpt-4","stream":true}"#).unwrap();
    let req = serde_json::from_value(req_json).unwrap();
    let client = liter_llm::create_client(std::env::var("API_KEY").expect("API_KEY must be set"), None, None, None, None).unwrap();
    let stream = client.chat_stream(req).await.expect("call failed");
    let chunks: Vec<_> = tokio_stream::StreamExt::collect::<Vec<_>>(stream).await
        .into_iter()
        .map(|r| r.expect("stream item failed"))
        .collect();
    println!("{:?}", chunks);
}
```
